# Sai Fine Arts

> Vocal, violin, veena, keyboard and guitar — teaching music for three generations, with more than 22,500 students coached.

## Key facts
- teaching music since 1940
- 22,500 students coached
- 450 students learning now

## Facilities
- Carnatic vocal
- Violin
- Veena
- Keyboard
- Guitar
- Western piano
- Western violin
- Ukulele
- Trinity grade exams (Western)
- Annamalai University grade exams
- Wednesday mini-concerts
- Margazhi Maha Utsav
- In-person & online classes
- Two classes a week

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Sai Fine Arts?
Viruksham, No. 21/9, Ground Floor, Veeraraghavan Street, Nanganallur, Chennai 600 061.

### What facilities does Sai Fine Arts have?
Carnatic vocal, Violin, Veena, Keyboard, Guitar, Western piano, Western violin, Ukulele, Trinity grade exams (Western), Annamalai University grade exams, Wednesday mini-concerts, Margazhi Maha Utsav, In-person & online classes, Two classes a week.

### How many classes are there?
Two classes per week — approximately eight classes a month. In-person and online classes are available.

### Can adults join?
Yes. Working professionals and college-goers can enrol too. It's never too late for music!

### How do I join Sai Fine Arts?
Pick a date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 98411 30158.
